title: The classes of failure to which each rule belongs

verses.t: When it comes to the offenses for having sexual intercourse, to how many of the four kinds of failure do they belong? They belong to two kinds of failure: they may be failure in morality; they may be failure in conduct. …

When it comes to the offense for, out of disrespect, defecating, urinating, or spitting in water, to how many of the four kinds of failure does it belong? It belongs to one kind of failure: failure in conduct.
The classes of failure to which each rule belongs, the third, are finished.
